quarterly_data.quarter: onsemi press release: onsemi and Synaptics Announce Revised Merger Agreement (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: onsemi and Synaptics amended their June 25, 2026 merger agreement to an all-cash structure (price terms not captured). The transaction has been approved by the United States Federal Trade Commission, regulators in other jurisdictions are reviewing it, and it is still expected to close by mid-2027, subject to Synaptics shareholder approval. CEO Hassane El-Khoury: Synaptics complements growth in onsemi's AI data center business and brings its human-machine interface and sensing products businesses; beyond the previously announced $200 million of annual run-rate synergies, onsemi has identified incremental opportunities from revenue synergies and insourcing of a portion of Synaptics' production, expected to be realized after the initial 18 months post-close.
quarterly_data.figure: $200 million annual run-rate synergies (previously announced); close expected by mid-2027
